meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证程序缺陷并修复,自动以 PR 或 issue 形式提交到正确仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你修好了某个工具的 Bug,却不确定该提 PR 还是开 issue。
copy.tagline_en: Verify and fix a defect, then submit it as the right pull request or issue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you fixed a bug but aren't sure whether to open a PR or an issue.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会复现你报的 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷,在临时工作区先写失败测试、再做最小修复并验证。上游 Codex 缺陷提 fork PR,LazyCodex 自身缺陷提带补丁的 issue。
howto.when: 当你要求修复 bug、给 bug 开 PR,或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。它先复现问题,再按仓库归属选择交付方式。

say.text: 帮我修这个 Codex CLI 的 bug,并向上游提 PR
say.note: 在临时克隆里复现验证后开 fork PR。

say.text: 调试这个 LazyCodex 的 bug,提交验证后的修复
say.note: 向 lazycodex 仓库提带补丁的 issue。

say.text: 先复现这个 bug,写一个失败的回归测试
say.note: 确认测试因该 bug 失败后再改代码。

howto.what_en: Claude reproduces the reported LazyCodex or Codex defect in a temp workspace, writes a failing test, applies the smallest fix, and verifies it. Upstream Codex bugs get a fork PR; LazyCodex bugs get a patch-embedded issue.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect. It reproduces first, then routes the fix by repository ownership.

say_en.text: Fix this Codex CLI bug and open an upstream PR
say_en.note: Reproduces in a temp clone, then forks and opens the PR.

say_en.text: Debug this LazyCodex bug and file the verified fix
say_en.note: Opens an issue with the patch on code-yeongyu/lazycodex.

say_en.text: Reproduce this bug and write a failing test first
say_en.note: Confirms a red test before touching production code.
